title: haex-hive Install Lockfile v2 (Spec 008 amended molecule shape)
description: Schema for `.haex-hive/install.lock` after the 2026-09-03 Spec 008 amendment. The current shape contains only the schema version, published generation ID, and molecule records. Legacy generated_by, constitution, atoms, contributed_paths, generation_inputs, participating_roots, and visibility_marker fields are rejected by the FR-005 schema/migration gate. Implemented against v3 vocabulary (Spec 013, landed 2026-09-04, one day after this amendment was written): the shipped const is "3", not "2" as this file's own name suggests.

molecules.$comment: The post-schema semantic validator requires lexicographic (id, source, revision, paths) ordering. JSON Schema cannot compare properties across array items. uniqueItems rejects duplicate full tuples.
molecules.description: One record per resolved molecule, canonically ordered by (id, source, revision, paths).

revision.description: Immutable full commit SHA per Constitution Principle IV.

paths.description: Unique, deterministically ordered POSIX paths relative to the consumer repository root.
